notes:
3D Studio can now turn a local PNG, JPEG or WebP into a saved model. Choose Image to 3D, pick a picture of one object, then select Create 3D model. The studio uses that picture directly as the reference. Both input modes show a rotating wireframe and scan line during generation. Shaping shows its actual step count. Progress and setup messages use plain language. Reduced-motion settings show a stationary wireframe.

On the Windows RTX 3060, a test picked an owl PNG through the native file dialog, verified its reference pixels, observed the animated and reduced-motion states, and checked the shaping steps. The resulting five-mesh GLB reopened from Saved models. A separate text-prompt job drew a reference and saved its own model. Also checked JPEG orientation and resizing, transparent PNG and WebP, and invalid image data.

Source commit d8c99f46ede9b827fd0548be1a69a56a9b1b2e51.
